description:
Business Development Representative \| Commercial Solar \& BESS  
**Vikta Energy \| Remote \| Full\-Time**  
**$60,000–$75,000 Base \+ Uncapped Commission \| $200K OTE**  
Ready to Take Your Solar Sales Career to the Commercial Side?  
If you’ve proven you can sell residential solar and are ready to move into larger commercial projects, this could be your opportunity.  
Vikta Energy is a Texas\-based EPC and electrical contractor delivering commercial and industrial solar, large\-scale Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), EV/DC fast charging, electrical infrastructure, select residential solar, and long\-term O\&M nationwide.  
We self\-perform our projects with our own teams, from design and construction through ongoing operations and maintenance. We’re also a Tesla Premier Installer and work closely with Tesla through our partnership.  
We’re growing quickly and building out our national commercial sales organization. We’re looking for a driven Business Development Representative who knows how to **HUNT** and wants the opportunity to grow with us.  
**Commercial solar experience is a plus, but it is not required.**  
We’re especially interested in successful residential solar salespeople who have built their business through cold calling, door knocking, referrals, networking, self\-generated leads, or other outbound prospecting and are ready to take the next step into commercial energy sales.  
About the Role  
This is a highly outbound, phone\-forward business development role.  
Your job is to find the right companies, identify decision\-makers, get them on the phone, start conversations, and create qualified opportunities for our commercial sales team.  
You’ll prospect into commercial and industrial businesses, property owners, developers, manufacturers, commercial real estate groups, facility operators, and other organizations that could benefit from solar, battery storage, EV charging, and energy infrastructure solutions.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer - Data Center
description:

You will also be a governing focal point for all site activities, ensuring site integrity and systems availability through the enforcement of corporate security and governance policies, information processing facility specifications, technology standards, processes, and disciplines.

You will oversee scheduling of installations, decommissions, research, and troubleshooting of hardware and environmental events related to data center availability. **Overview**
------------



**Global Category Manager \- Utilities, Travel \& Fleet**
**Location: Remote (US) \| Eastern Time Zone Preferred or Europe (EU)**
**Morgan Advanced Materials**
=====================================================================================================


We’re building a new global procurement structure, and this role will help shape how it works.
As Global Category Manager for Utilities, Travel and Fleet, you’ll take strategic ownership of three important areas of indirect spend. Utilities will be the core of your expertise, and you’ll need several years’ hands\-on experience managing utilities across **both the US and European markets**.
This isn’t a role where you’ll simply inherit a category plan and keep it ticking over. You’ll be the subject matter expert, setting the direction, challenging existing approaches and helping the wider business make better commercial decisions.
**The Role**
------------


You’ll create and lead global category strategies that improve value, reduce risk and manage total cost of ownership. The wider portfolio covers Travel and Fleet, but Utilities is the non\-negotiable technical requirement.
You’ll work with senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams across different countries, turning spend data and market insight into practical sourcing plans. You’ll also lead major supplier negotiations, build stronger supplier relationships and make sure agreed changes are implemented, not quietly filed away after the presentation  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------



**What you’ll do**
* **Lead** the global category strategy for Utilities, Travel and Fleet, with Utilities as the principal area of expertise.
* **Develop** sourcing strategies that reflect the different energy markets, regulations, commercial models and supplier landscapes across the US and Europe.
